title: Product Recall: My First Baby Spinner sold by The Works (2609-0229)

products.name: My First Baby Spinner
products.description: Spinning toy with suction-cup base, intended for babies/toddlers. Colours may vary.

hazard_text: The product presents a risk of choking as it has small parts that can detach or break off during reasonably foreseeable use.
instructions: The product has been recalled from end users by The Works. Measures: recall-of-product-from-end-users.
summary: Playworks My First Baby Spinner is recalled because of a risk of choking. Stop using it.
